reason: The pay-on-delivery thing is literally the first question I ask any JustDial guy -- 'what if he doesn't turn up or does a shoddy job' -- so I'd try it once for something small to see if the refund actually works the way they say.
objection: They admit the number of real bookings near me is still small while they onboard the first batch -- so the rating and job-count I'm supposed to trust isn't really there yet in Coimbatore, it's mostly a promise.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing a handful of pros in my own area with actual completed jobs and ratings, not just the zero or near-zero count they're upfront about -- and one friend or neighbour telling me the refund actually paid out when someone ghosted them.
